Name: Isekai Bonds - Seven Heroines Character Pack
Author: Alex3108
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Seven Heroines Character Pack[/b] is a non-explicit expansion for [b]Valley Bonds: Isekai Bonds[/b].
The pack adds seven original heroines from different worlds, each with her own visual theme, personality, bond progression, story content, contracts, portraits, and reward profile.
Meet noble travelers, cyber mages, celestial seers, gothic treasure hunters, otherworldly idols, ocean royalty, and angelic guardians as they enter the Valley through the rift.
This pack contains no nudity or explicit sexual content. Some portraits feature revealing or lingerie-inspired outfits.[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]Included heroines[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Elara Snowveil[/b] — a graceful runaway heiress with a noble and social reward profile. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Nova Lumen[/b] — a magical synthetic being connected to cyber technology. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Seraphine Glint[/b] — an angelic guardian focused on support and protection. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Ravenna Nocturne[/b] — a mysterious gothic treasure hunter drawn to cursed relics. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Mira Nix[/b] — an energetic otherworldly idol with market and performance-themed rewards. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Thalassa Crown[/b] — an ocean-born ruler associated with fishing and marine treasures. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Astra Veil[/b] — a celestial seer who reads the future through impossible stars.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]SMAPI[/b]. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]Valley Bonds[/b]. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]Valley Bonds: Isekai Bonds[/b]. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this character pack. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the pack into mods folder[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI. [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]The heroines will appear as part of the weekly rotating roster. Not all seven characters will necessarily appear during the same week.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Seven original heroines. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Unique character themes and personalities. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Personal bond progression. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Story chapters and relationship scenes. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Multiple unlockable portraits. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Custom contracts. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Unique reward profiles and themed reward caches. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Bond Cards unlocked at maximum bond level. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]English and Russian localization. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Compatible with the weekly heroine rotation. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]No required expansion mods beyond Valley Bonds and Isekai Bonds.[/color]
